create_AVgrageMeter: create an AvgrageMeter instance to track running averages of training loss or accuracy
use_accuracy: use the accuracy function to compute top-k classification accuracy from model output and targets
create_Cutout: create a Cutout data augmentation transform that randomly masks rectangular regions of images
use_data_transforms_cifar10: use _data_transforms_cifar10 to build train and validation transforms for CIFAR-10 with optional cutout
use_drop_path: use drop_path to apply stochastic depth regularization to a 4D tensor during training
